title: Shinonome Ena — Creating Something Worth Seeing〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I tried making it so the viewer's eyes are drawn toward this girl's face...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But it still doesn't feel right...
Maybe I should rethink this design and... Wait, no!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Geez, I left these lines completely black...! I'll have to recolor these parts too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on a sec. I don't have to now if I'm gonna do an overhaul.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Is this better?
I guess I can just ask Kanade later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu's story was so interesting that I forgot to keep working on this. Hopefully, I've made up for that lost time now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, two years ago...)

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: I wouldn't bother.

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: You don't have the talent to become an artist.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Was everything I did until now just a complete waste of time?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I don't have any talent, so it doesn't matter how hard I work?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: I get that you're not gonna be of any help now...! I'll become an even greater artist than you on my own!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I got so mad that time that I really sat down to study art in order to get back at him...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I still couldn't get into the school I wanted.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After that, I kept studying, but it became more and more painful with each passing day...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I became so frustrated...
It felt like the whole world was laughing at me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I unloaded on Akito, Mom and everyone else around me back then as a way to vent too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I couldn't do anything with my art, while my peers kept making progress toward their dreams...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting left behind like that made me feel like a total wreck...)

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Shut up! I said I'm not hungry, didn't I?!

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
I know...
You don't have to eat if you don't want to...

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line: But why don't we watch some TV together? Your friend just happens to be on right now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mother's Voice
rows.Line:
Airi Momoi.
Akito told me that she's your friend...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: A-Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Show MC
rows.Line: <Our guest today is the new idol group that everybody's talking about right now... QT!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Lovely☆　Fairy☆　Airi... Momoi!!
I'm Airi Momoi, the heart-seeking idol♪>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (When's the last time we saw each other...?)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, I think it was when she said she'd be going to Miya Girls. But that couldn't have been that long ago...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
You did it, Airi.
You actually achieved your dream of becoming an idol.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: While I...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I even recorded all the other shows I could find that she's been on...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Y-You did?! Can I watch them now?

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Of course. Why don't you have some food while you do?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I will...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seeing Airi on TV made me want to keep going and keep trying.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, I've been helped by so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When I made a submission for the Shibuya Art Contest, Kanade's song and Rin were there to cheer me up.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Also, I'm the artist for N25!
My contribution to this group will always be my art!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's take another hard look at this illustration and find ways to improve it.
